snippet.title: Another Satisfactory Announcement
snippet.description:
We told you there'd be stuff to dig into.

Wishlist here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5276140
https://store.epicgames.com/p/satisfactory--core-values-expansion
[PS5 & Xbox coming soon!]

Taking the Satisfactory gameplay to new depths.

Core Values is the first paid DLC for Satisfactory and a major expansion.

Pioneers will reach into the crust of MASSAGE 2(A-B)b in a different setting with new resources, flora, fauna and more as you develop an underground factory network with new production lines and buildings, uncovering more about the world the deeper you go as you Construct, Automate, Explore & Exploit while continuing to uphold FICSIT's Core Values.

⬇ Links and Info ⬇
Website + FAQ ‣ https://satisfactorygame.com 
NEW Community Wiki ‣ https://satisfactory.wiki.gg/

CHAPTERS
00:00 - 

#Satisfactory is an FPS open-world factory building sim by #CoffeeStain Studios. You play as an engineer on an alien planet as part of the ‘Save The Day’ program - a program whose goal is to construct a massive machine for a mysterious purpose. Conquer nature, build multi-story factories, and automate to satisfaction!
